ctx.x: And then when Mama died and I went to Chicago, well, my husband ________ told me that he was getting her, and his brother was kind of fooling around with Jerry Lee (PHONETIC) and that's the girl I ________ -- she was much older than I was, you know -- and he say (unintelligible), say, " ________ get old Mack to come here. (Unintelligible) said, "Sippie can play music for us," you know. So (unintelligible).
Well, did anybody try to hit on you while you were playing the piano?
